rejected_providers.reason: Actual 2026-08-10 provider preflight returned HTTP 404 and 'This server has been turned off'.
GitHub provides a free Windows 11 arm64 runner, but Rhino 8 for Windows officially requires a 64-bit Intel or AMD processor and lists ARM processors as unsupported.
GitHub standard Windows x64 images are Windows Server. McNeel requires Core-Hour Billing when Rhino runs on Windows Server, so this violates NO_PAID_RUNTIME.
McNeel's Linux Compute guide requires a Core-Hour Billing Token; NO_PAID_RUNTIME forbids that token.
McNeel Compute FAQ states Rhino.Compute does not work on macOS.
McNeel supports local Compute with a standard Rhino licence/evaluation, but the current OLEANDER execution policy explicitly excludes the user's workstation.
